title: Masoom Sakina Rovay Kadon Mukniyaan Ne Aye Sazaawaan
body:
Seenay Tay Sorn Wali Mitiyan Tay Sondi Raiyan
Babay Nu Yaad Karkay, Qaidan Ch Rondi Paiyan
Phupiyan Vi Naal Koyi Nai X2, Mein Keray Paasay Jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindan Da Hanera , Was Lag Da Nay O Mera
Koi Nazar Nai O Aunda, Mera Haal Vekhay Kera
Menu Yaad Aundiyan Nay X2, Chachay Diyan Wafawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Qaid Khaana Jaway, Baun Uchiyan Nay Deewaran,
Veeran Day Deray Karbal, Hun Kis Nu Main Pukaran
Mere Naal Rehgayan Nay X2, Hun Hokay Naal Haawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Zalim Nay Dur Lahaye, Hoay Nay Zakam Kari
Maray Laeen Tamachay, Kallan Chon Khoon Jari
Kisay Akay Na Churaya X2, Mein Deindi Rayi Sadawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemar Ay Muhari, Nalay Zakhmi Aunda Seena
Pairan Ch Painay Chalay, Haye Mar Gayi Sakina
Peya Sochda Ay Abid X2, Edi Laash Kinj Uthawan
